title: fix(console): Audit Log's object filter is picked from the served objects (objectui#13165)
body:
Fixes #13165

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Audit Log's Object filter (`apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`) is now a searchable picker of the objects the console's metadata serves. It replaces the free-text box that sat under the placeholder "e.g. account".

- Each option reads `Label (name)`, the spelling the object-ref picker gives an object (`objectRefOptionLabel` from `@object-ui/fields`). Options are sorted by that label in the display locale.
- Choosing one commits the object's API name, as the Actor filter's `sys_user` lookup commits a user id (objectui#11701).
- "Any object" is the unfiltered state. Choosing the chosen object again, or "Clear filters", removes the filter.
- The visible "Object" label now names the control through `htmlFor` / `id`, because a `combobox` takes no accessible name from its content. No literal `aria-label` is added.
- The query is unchanged. The list fetch still sends `object_name` as a plain-value equality in `$filter` to `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log`.
- No object is named in the page. The options come from `useMetadata().objects`, the served registry the presets already read, so the picker costs no new request.

## The hypotheses, measured on `origin/main` `186b78d`

- **H1, the producer: confirmed, with one correction.** `load()` put the box's trimmed text into `filter.object_name`, serialized it into `$filter` and sent it to the data door `/api/v1/data/sys_audit_log`. That is an exact equality. The correction: the placeholder was not drawn from any app. It was the hard-coded literal "e.g. account" in the page.
- **H2, pick rather than type: confirmed.** The page already reads `useMetadata().objects` for its presets. That is the whole served registry, the `object` type list behind `MetadataProvider`'s `objects` getter. The ledger's writers in objectstack name either the audited object itself (`ctx.object` in `audit-writers.ts`) or one of four platform objects:
  - `sys_session`, for login and logout;
  - `sys_setting` and `sys_platform_setting`, for config changes;
  - `sys_user`, for user administration and import.

  All four are declared in `packages/platform-objects`, so they are registered objects. The contains-match alternative was rejected on a measurement as well as on taste. objectstack's ledger read gate (`namedParentObjects` in `parent-record-read-gate.ts`) reads only a plain value, `$eq` or `$in` on `object_name` as a confinement. A contains operator would lose that narrowing, and this card is not about the door's filter semantics.
- **H3, controls: pinned.**
  - Clearing, by re-picking or by "Clear filters", sends no `$filter` and lists every row.
  - Action and Actor each join the object filter in one `$filter`.
  - Paging keeps the object filter, and picking a new object starts again at page 1.
- **H4, acceptance: pinned, and it goes red with the fix reverted.** Choosing Accounts sends `object_name` equal to `crm_account` and lists only its rows. Typing `account`, the card's own example, into the picker's search finds Accounts.

## Tests

- New: `AuditLogPage.objectFilter-13165.test.tsx`, 8 tests.
- Updated: `AuditLogPage.presets-12667.test.tsx`. Its preset-joins-the-bar pin drove the removed text box. It now picks `account` through the picker and asserts the same filter as before.

Run at head `a47caf8`, through the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the four `AuditLogPage.*` suites, `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` and `orphanedPageComponentRefs-10520.test.tsx`. Result: `Test Files  6 passed (6)`, `Tests  51 passed (51)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Ablation (one-off, no permanent file)

The fix was committed first (`2583e95`). Then only `AuditLogPage.tsx` was checked out from base `186b78d` (blob `a240710`), with a trap that restores from `HEAD`.

- **The mutation landed on disk.** `objectFilterOptionsOf` went from 3 occurrences to 0. `placeholder="e.g. account"` went from 0 to 1 (counted in the two blobs).
- **The new file went red: `Tests  8 failed (8)`.** One test failed because the free-text input was present. The others failed on `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "combobox" and name "Object"`. That is the predicted direction.
- **The restore is proven.** `git checkout HEAD -- path`; the disk blob `4aa9e0d` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.

## Gates (local subset, at `a47caf8`; exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint`: exit 0, `0 errors, 220 warnings`. The two warnings on `AuditLogPage.tsx`, `catch (err: any)` and the setState-in-effect, were already on main.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, after building the closure with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/console^..." build` (exit 0). `tsc --listFiles` lists all four `AuditLogPage.*` test files, so the check covers them.
- Each of these exited 0:
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new)
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (1 changeset declared)
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`
  - `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs`
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the four paths answers NOT GOVERNED.
- Not run locally, because they belong to CI: the full test shards and the repo-wide lint. No i18n gate applies, since no string moved into a translation table.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13165-audit-log-object-picker.md` is a `patch` for `@object-ui/console`. The changeset-presence gate asks for it because `apps/console` is in the release's fixed group, although no export, prop or accept set moves.

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- **The shared `Combobox` searches option values only.** `CommandItem` gets `value={option.value}` and no `keywords`, so typing an object's visible label finds nothing unless its letters also occur, in order, in the API name. A happy-dom probe, not committed, typed into a `Combobox` holding `Accounts (crm_account)` and `Opportunities (crm_opportunity)`:
  - `Accounts` and `Opportunities` showed no option;
  - `account` and `crm_opp` showed the matching one.

  The limitation lives in `packages/components/src/custom/combobox.tsx` and reaches every consumer whose labels differ from its values, the object-ref field included. Fixing it moves a published package, so it is outside this card's surface. No real-browser reading was taken, and there is no carrier.
- **Other controls still lack a name tied to their label.** The Action select, the From/To date inputs and the Actor lookup trigger keep their visible labels unassociated. The test DOM dump shows the Action select as a `combobox` with an empty name. Pre-existing and left as it was.
- **The table and drawer still print the raw API name.** The Object column and the drawer title show `object_name`, not the label. Polish, left as it was.
- **Rows of an unserved object cannot be reached by this filter.** An object the metadata no longer serves (a deleted one, say) is not offered, so the filter cannot narrow the ledger to its old rows. The changeset says so too.
